name: ​Happily ever after
source:
Deep in a snow-covered forest, 'you' awaken in an unfamiliar mansion. According to the young man who owns the house, it seems you got lost in the blizzard. Explore the mansion and, while regaining your memories, try to return home.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12491]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
在白雪皑皑的密林深处，“你”在一栋陌生的洋馆中醒来。据洋馆主人那位青年所说，你似乎是在暴风雪中迷了路。探索这座洋馆，在找回记忆的同时设法重返家园吧。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12491]Novel Game Collection[/url]]
